blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Mars Alba sealed the win as Akari survived Choco Mucho in five sets, 25-19, 22-25, 25-21, 19-25, 16-14, in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Saturday night at Philsports Arena. Alba finished off the Flying Titans with a clutch solo block against former teammate Sisi Rondina-Rosales, then confidently celebrated by pointing skyward with a wide smile. The Chargers rushed toward Alba and carried their setter, who delivered 19 excellent sets and three points, as they improved to 3-3 and joined the Flying Titans in a tie in the standings. “Thank the Lord lang,” said Alba in […]...
